heroTitleLine1: Seamless tracking from case to pallet,
heroSub: In order to ensure case-pallet traceability in all of Mey Diageo's factories, a robust, user-friendly and flexible traceability system has been implemented as part of renewing the existing system.
contextP1: In order to ensure case-pallet traceability in all of Mey Diageo's factories, a robust, user-friendly and flexible traceability system has been implemented as part of renewing the existing system.
contextP2: The project aimed to enable traceability extending from case to pallet across all factories.
problemLede: Renewal of the existing traceability system was required to reliably ensure traceability from case to pallet. In addition, restricted ERP access during network drops required a flexible, continuously operating structure to prevent production downtime.

problemList.text: The risk of production stopping in cases where connection with the central ERP system is lost.
Inability to centrally monitor cases and pallets produced in a multi-factory structure in real time.

solutionLede: To enable case-to-pallet traceability, barcodes of cases from production lines are scanned and paired with matching pallet barcodes. Fully integrated with SAP, the system operates offline during network drops, ensuring uninterrupted production. The application runs in all Mey Diageo factories and production lines, monitored from headquarters in Istanbul, with production reports generated centrally.

steps.title: Case Scanning
steps.text: Barcodes of cases coming from the production line are scanned via industrial readers.

steps.title: Pallet Matching
steps.text: Scanned case info is matched with the corresponding pallet ID.

steps.title: Offline Operation
steps.text: If a network drop occurs, the system automatically continues operating in local memory.

steps.title: SAP Sync
steps.text: When connection is restored, all accumulated data is automatically pushed to SAP.

techGrid.title: C# SCADA Application
techGrid.text: Interface managing case-pallet matching, labeling flow, and SAP integration.

techGrid.title: Case and Pallet Applicators
techGrid.text: Industrial machines automatically printing and applying case and pallet labels.

techGrid.title: Industrial Barcode Readers
techGrid.text: Field readers scanning case and pallet barcodes with high speed and accuracy.

techGrid.title: OnSuite Trace Platform
techGrid.text: Traceability software featuring offline capability and central reporting.

integrationDesc: The system operates fully integrated with SAP bi-directionally. During network drops, the application switches to offline mode to keep production running without interruption, and syncs data once the connection is restored.

integrationList.text: Interruption period data stored in the local database is transferred to SAP when connection is established.

resultsGrid.title: End-to-End Traceability
resultsGrid.text: The entire packaging hierarchy from case to pallet is automatically recorded.

resultsGrid.title: Offline Reliability
resultsGrid.text: Factory production does not stop even during network or SAP drops, preserving data integrity.

resultsGrid.title: Central Reporting
resultsGrid.text: Traceability data from all factories can be monitored in real time from headquarters in Istanbul.
